name: pvc-full-from-logs
why_hard: A database volume is full, which points at data growth. The table data barely moved; an application log file on the same volume grew to 8GiB because rotation stopped working after a config change.

annotations.description: The PersistentVolume claimed by data-postgres-0 in demo is only 2% free.

k8s_events: Warning FreeDiskSpaceFailed node/worker3: failed to garbage collect required amount of images
log_lines: postgres: LOG checkpoint complete: wrote 812 buffers
sidecar: WARN logrotate skipped: unknown directive in /etc/logrotate.d/app since 2026-08-19
